'''Jason Lumsden''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Bravo 17 from Springfield, Il. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables.
